data.name: Bomb The Monsters!
data.detailed_description:
Promised: You will love this addictive game!

Don't make these monsters angry! Fire your bombs at those lousy creatures and get buildings to collapse on them. With lovely HD graphics and awesome physics!

"Bomb the Monsters!" features the story of a highly talented painter who is living a perfect life with his beloved wife. But one day things are changing when a huge horde of ugly monsters invade planet earth, capture the painter's wife, and exhaust and exploit the whole planet. Now it's up to the player to stop this horrible invasion and rescue the poor hostage - easier said than done!

The very well-known gameplay offers an easy entry into the game: In every level the player needs to place a limited amount of bombs next to the monsters for getting surroundings and buildings collapse on them to drive the monsters out. But the monsters are coming in various sizes and shapes and are fat, imbecile and extremely sticky. Because of the physical structure of their bodies, these stupid creatures stick to almost everything what makes it sometimes tricky to bomb them away.

"Bomb the Monsters!" offers over 60 levels in beautiful HD graphics; each level comes with non-linear solutions to eliminate the ugly monsters. Great music and sounds plus a motivating achievement system are part of this addictive mobile game as well and offering fun for the whole family.

FEATURES:

* Easy to learn, hard to master!
* Addictive and very famous game play
* 60 levels, divided into 6 different worlds
* Realistic physics. Everything in the game uses physics attributes such as mass, force, friction and gravity!
* Non-linear solutions for each and every levels
* Breath-taking animations
* Great music and awesome sound effects.
* Motivating achievement system with more than 10 unlockable items.
* Multilingual

reviews.review:
# Introduction

"Bomb The Monsters!" is a physics-based puzzle game released on November 6, 2015, developed by Finalboss game studio. The game combines simple controls, cartoonish visuals, and physics-based puzzles into a surprisingly entertaining experience. The goal is simple: use a limited number of bombs to make buildings and objects collapse onto the monsters and get rid of them.

# Gameplay

At its core, Bomb The Monsters! is a puzzle game focused heavily on physics, timing, and experimentation. Each level gives you a limited number of bombs, meaning you have to think about where to place them and how the surrounding structures will react.

The physics system is the main attraction. Mass, gravity, force, and friction all affect how objects behave, and there are often multiple ways to solve a level. Some solutions are straightforward, while others require you to experiment until you find the perfect chain reaction.

The game features over 60 levels divided into 6 different worlds, giving you plenty of puzzles to work through.

# Visuals and Audio

The visuals are colorful, simple, and cartoonish, fitting the lighthearted nature of the game perfectly. The monsters have goofy designs, while the environments are designed mainly around making the physics easy to understand.

The sound effects and music are nothing revolutionary, but they do their job well. Explosions, collapsing structures, and monster reactions make every successful solution feel satisfying.

# Strengths

**Fun Physics:** Watching everything collapse after placing a bomb correctly is surprisingly satisfying.

**Simple Gameplay:** The controls and objective are easy to understand, making it possible to jump in without much explanation.

**Multiple Solutions:** Many levels can be completed in different ways, giving you some freedom to experiment.

**Lots of Levels:** With more than 60 levels across 6 worlds, there is a decent amount of content for a small puzzle game.

# Weaknesses

**Can Become Repetitive:** The basic formula stays mostly the same throughout the game.

**Trial and Error:** Some puzzles require experimenting with different bomb placements until you figure out what works.

**Simple Presentation:** While the cartoon style fits the game, players looking for impressive visuals may find it fairly basic.

**Limited Replayability:** Once you've solved most of the puzzles, there isn't a huge reason to come back unless you're trying to improve your solutions or achievements.

# Final

Bomb The Monsters! is a simple and entertaining physics puzzle game that doesn't try to be anything more than it needs to be. The gameplay is easy to understand but can become surprisingly tricky when the levels start getting more complicated.

It's the kind of game you can open for a few minutes and suddenly realize you've been playing for an hour. The physics are the real star of the show, and experimenting with different ways to destroy the monsters is genuinely fun.

**Final Rating: 2/10**

**Who Should Play:** Players who enjoy casual physics puzzles, goofy cartoon games, and simple gameplay with plenty of experimentation.

**Who Might Pass:** Players looking for a deep story, complex mechanics, or a game with lots of replay value.

Overall, Bomb The Monsters! is a fun little puzzle game with satisfying physics and enough levels to keep you entertained for a while.

**I only bought it for the Steam trading cards LOL**
